profile.headline: Graphics Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Software Engineer at Apple, experienced software engineer with a focus on graphics and core.

positions.title: R&D Tools Engineer (Cinematics)
positions.description:
Collaborated with technical directors and artists to develop and maintain animation pipeline tools. Rewrote Renderman filters for effects team into procedural plugins. Incorporated new plugins into proprietary lighting tool, and developed new authoring pipeline along with effects artists.
Authored volume selection tool utilizing the Maya API, allowing for selection of intersecting volumes using geometric shapes as well as primitives.
Created renaming tool for Maya, supporting various studio naming conventions (using dynamically generated regular expressions), filtering, and search/replace functionality. Fully integrated tool into Maya using pyQT.

positions.title: Global Tech TD Resident
positions.description:
Performed extensive work on vegetation rendering pipeline, particularly on procedural geometry-generating Renderman plugin. Significantly improved library, adding support for instancing of object hierarchies, emission of PRMan primvars, geometry coalescing/baking, and artist-controlled pruning capabilities. Collaborated with tools team to develop a representation of new features within Pixar-specific file format.
Significantly reduced memory usage of vegetation rendering by implementing PRMan-instanced output, and testing the new instancing feature with the Renderman team. Thoroughly tested plugin, including extensive analysis of PRMan rendering stats. Developed GI tracing optimization which significantly reduces memory footprint for rendering.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of developers to design and implement various visualization tools, each based on government customer requirements
 3DTV (3D Terrain Visualization) project – Loads DTED and CADRG satellite imagery and generates heightmapped navigable 3D terrain. Presented work at the Pentagon, and to Congress members at Capitol Hill in February 2003.
 Data Visualization tool – implemented several visualizations for data, including frequency analysis tool, radial graph, bar/line graphs, parallel graph, space-filling curve graph, and 2D/3D maps
 Various other work – Developed graphics for MDTT (Master Digital Training Tool), an online graphical training tool for Army soldiers, and for BIMS (inventory management). Built 3d prototypes for Disaster City project proposal.

positions.title: Geometry R&D Intern
positions.description: Collaborated with R&D supervisor on CSG tool for polygonal meshes. Implemented several new features in addition to those requested by artists. Significantly improved performance (halved computation time) by utilizing spatial hashing for vertex merging. Identified/fixed various stability and robustness issues. Introduced various profiling-based optimizations and significant code cleanup/reorganization. Built a wiki page explaining changes, new features and artist tips for producing good CSG operations. Extensively tested tool using Python scripts.
